summary: After construction ends at {place}, crews still have invasive plants to clear.
realLife: King County continued removing weeds and planting native vegetation at the completed restoration site.
gates: A restored site has reached construction closeout and has a maintenance plan.
weights: More invasive growth during inspection increases the priority of a return visit.
inGame: needs: maintenance visits after project completion.

turns.what: The county closes routine maintenance at the site.
turns.pulledBy: A follow-up inspection finds that native vegetation meets the agreed target.
turns.writesBack: The inspection closes the work order.

turns.what: The crew returns after the growing season.
turns.pulledBy: Site access is restricted while wildlife is nesting.
turns.writesBack: The maintenance order records the new work window.
